install: set -euo pipefail; dotnet restore src/TrelloCli.csproj --locked-mode --nologo; dotnet pack src/TrelloCli.csproj --configuration Release --no-restore --nologo; dotnet tool update --global --add-source src/nupkg TrelloCli; sed -i '/case \$- in/,/esac/d' ~/.bashrc 2>/dev/null || true; grep -qxF 'export PATH="$HOME/.dotnet/tools:$PATH"' ~/.bashrc || echo 'export PATH="$HOME/.dotnet/tools:$PATH"' >> ~/.bashrc; mkdir -p ~/.agents/skills ~/.claude/skills; ln -sfn "$PWD/plugins/trello-cli/skills/trello-cli" ~/.agents/skills/trello-cli; ln -sfn "$PWD/plugins/trello-cli/skills/trello-cli" ~/.claude/skills/trello-cli
